questions.prompt: What is the main subject of the sentence: 'The new policy, which was introduced last year, has reduced traffic in the city centre.'?
questions.explanation: 句子主干的主语是'The new policy'，'which was introduced last year'是修饰它的定语从句。
questions.evidence: The new policy, which was introduced last year, has reduced traffic in the city centre.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct passive form: 'The report ______ by the committee last week.'
questions.explanation: 报告是被批准的，且时间状语是last week，所以用一般过去时的被动语态was approved。
questions.evidence: The report was approved by the committee last week.

questions.prompt: Identify the noun phrase in the sentence: 'The rapid growth of online shopping has changed retail.'
options: The rapid growth of online shopping
answers: The rapid growth of online shopping
questions.explanation: 主语是一个名词短语，中心词是growth，带有形容词rapid和介词短语of online shopping作修饰。
questions.evidence: The rapid growth of online shopping has changed retail.

questions.prompt: Which sentence is in the passive voice?
options: The project was discussed by the students.
The students are discussing the project.
The project will be discussed by the students.
answers: The project was discussed by the students.
questions.explanation: 被动语态的结构是be + 过去分词。选项B和D都是被动语态，但题目要求选出一个，B是明确被动。
questions.evidence: The project was discussed by the students.

questions.prompt: What is the head noun of the phrase 'the number of local jobs that would be created'?
questions.explanation: 名词短语的中心词是number，of local jobs that would be created是修饰成分。
questions.evidence: the number of local jobs that would be created

questions.prompt: Choose the correct passive form: 'New apartments ______ in the area at the moment.'
questions.explanation: 表示正在被建造，用现在进行时的被动语态are being built。
questions.evidence: New apartments are being built in the area at the moment.

questions.prompt: In the sentence 'The council, after long discussions, decided to approve the plan.', what is the main verb?
questions.explanation: 主语是The council，谓语是decided，after long discussions是插入的介词短语。
questions.evidence: The council, after long discussions, decided to approve the plan.

questions.prompt: Which is the correct passive transformation of 'They will announce the results tomorrow'?
options: The results will be announced tomorrow.
answers: The results will be announced tomorrow.
questions.explanation: 一般将来时的被动语态是will be + 过去分词。
questions.evidence: The results will be announced tomorrow.

instructions: 先阅读本组中文规则与原句，区分新结构和已学规则，再完成独立句子；同一材料再次出现属于巩固，保持原ID。
passage:
在学术英语中，句子往往较长，但核心是主干（主语+谓语+宾语）。修饰成分（如定语从句、介词短语）会附加在主干上。名词短语常包含多个修饰语。被动语态（be + 过去分词）常用于客观陈述，强调动作承受者。例如：'The project was designed by experts.' 本课重点：识别主干，理解修饰关系，并正确使用被动语态。

The project, called the Riverside Renewal, aims to transform an old industrial area into a mix of apartments, offices, and public parks.
